description: Manage the container images on the atomic host platform.

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: Define the backend where the image is pulled. Choices: "docker" "ostree"

parameters.name: started
parameters.description: Start or stop the container. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state of the container image. The state latest will ensure container image is upgraded to the latest version and forcefully restart container, if running. Choices: "absent" "latest" ← (default) "present"

examples:
- name: Execute the run command on rsyslog container image (atomic run rhel7/rsyslog)
  community.general.atomic_image:
    name: rhel7/rsyslog
    state: latest

- name: Pull busybox to the OSTree backend
  community.general.atomic_image:
    name: busybox
    state: latest
    backend: ostree

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: The command standard output. Returned: always Sample: "Using default tag: latest ..."
